reference: Owner-supplied screenshot of the persona rail, used only as a style reference.

assets.name: keeper
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / transparent avatar asset.
Edit the supplied screenshot by extracting and fully re-illustrating ONLY the warm sandstone-colored happy mascot above the label "intentic" in the TOP LEFT avatar row. The screenshot is a visual reference; discard the entire interface and every other character.
Create one beautifully finished standalone mascot on a genuinely transparent background. Match the reference character closely: a cute plump rounded squishy pebble body, warm cream sandstone color, softly sculpted 3D clay/velvet shading, tiny chubby hands and feet, cheerful closed crescent eyes and a small kind smile. It wears a small exquisite antique-gold Khmer lotus/flame crown at the top, small gold leaf ear ornaments, and a simple gold lotus collar/belt at the base. Gold should feel engraved and softly metallic with clear simplified leaf shapes. Its little hands rest together in front. Face and round silhouette are the focus; restrained ornament.
Composition: square icon, whole body including crown and feet visible, centered and symmetrical, fills about 88% of canvas height and 80% width, generous transparent edge. Front view with slight sculptural depth. Smooth clean silhouette, sharp high-quality rendering, soft warm key light upper left. Readable at 72 pixels. NO text, labels, UI, frame, backdrop, checkerboard pattern, pedestal, watermark, glow, halo or cast ground shadow. No mechanical robot body, no photoreal human, no deity portrait. A tiny friendly original assistant mascot matching the reference. Output a square transparent PNG.

assets.name: scholar
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Edit the supplied transparent mascot into one sibling for an app avatar library. Preserve the exact premium sculpted soft-clay illustration style, antique gold Khmer lotus crown and side leaf ornaments, tiny feet, friendly plump body, front view, warm upper-left light, clean alpha edge and framing. Keep it round and squishy, a simple blob creature. Crown should be delicately smaller, about 17% of total character height; gold remains warm antique gold. Face is always clearly visible. One whole-body character centered in a square filling about 88% canvas height. All unused pixels genuinely transparent. No text labels, scene, frame, halo, ground shadow, or UI. Change only the identity features described below.
Sibling identity: Make the body muted lavender-purple. Give it large round antique-gold spectacles, two clear dark round eyes inside them and a tiny gentle smile. Chubby little arms rest at the front. Curious and thoughtful, like the purple UX Expert mascot in the original reference. Do not add a book: the round glasses are its one signature accessory.
